title: Sunseeker 90 Ocean
highlights: Beam over 7 m: volume of a 100-footer
description:
A brand-new Sunseeker 90 Ocean, just arrived in Phuket. With a beam of over seven metres, her interior and outdoor areas offer the volume of a 100-footer, perfect for Southeast Asia cruising.

Twin MAN V12-1900 engines give a 24-knot cruise, with advanced stabilisers for comfort. Highlights include a spectacular beach club with X-TEND sunbeds, an expansive flybridge, Miele appliances, panoramic saloon windows and a full-beam master suite.
